changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE uploaded_file ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), original_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, content_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, sha256 CHAR(64) NOT NULL, storage_path VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, purpose VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('ENTRY','KNOWLEDGE')), uploaded_by UUID REFERENCES app_user(id), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX idx_uploaded_file_sha256 ON uploaded_file (sha256);
